consistency._design_extensions_pending: Broader consistency design (ontology-style disjointness checks, cross-attribute constraints) is still pending. validity_per_column is the first first-class consistency signal.

task_step._design_intent: Integrate per-stage metrics from PyDI.{schemamatching,entitymatching,fusion}.evaluation. Caller passes them in via the optional task_step_metrics kwarg; orchestrator packs them verbatim into this block.

aggregated._design_intent: Two-dimensional weighting (Quality × Reference). Revisit after collecting first metric results across multiple pipelines. headline.<level>.composite_score carries a per-reference-level single-axis composite in the meantime.
